segments.normalizedSource: ```swift @IBAction func scalePiece(_ gestureRecognizer: UIPinchGestureRecognizer) { guard gestureRecognizer.view != nil else { return } if gestureRecognizer.state == .began || gestureRecognizer.state == .changed { gestureRecognizer.view?.transform = (gestureRecognizer.view?.transform. scaledBy(x: gestureRecognizer.scale, y: gestureRecognizer.scale))! gestureRecognizer.scale = 1.0 } } ```
